t: 波希米亚的查理四世被伦巴第铁冠封为米兰的意大利国王.
te: Charles IV of Bohemia is crowned with the Iron Crown of Lombardy as King of Italy in Milan.
dz: 波希米亚的查理四世被伦巴第铁冠封为米兰的意大利国王.
de: Charles IV of Bohemia is crowned with the Iron Crown of Lombardy as King of Italy in Milan.

t: 英国牛津爆发了"圣学日"暴动,使得63名学者和或许有30名当地人两天后死亡.
te: The St Scholastica Day riot breaks out in Oxford, England, leaving 63 scholars and perhaps 30 locals dead in two days.
dz: 英国牛津爆发了"圣学日"暴动,使得63名学者和或许有30名当地人两天后死亡.

t: 在"红巾起义"中,被宋朝皇帝惠宗宣称为"后人"的汉林尔被封为"恢复了的宋朝"博州"的皇帝.
te: Amidst the Red Turban Rebellions, Han Lin'er, a claimed descendant of Emperor Huizong of Song, is proclaimed emperor of…
dz: 在"红巾起义"中,被宋朝皇帝惠宗宣称为"后人"的汉林尔被封为"恢复了的宋朝"博州"的皇帝.
de: Amidst the Red Turban Rebellions, Han Lin'er, a claimed descendant of Emperor Huizong of Song, is proclaimed emperor of the restored Song dynasty in Bozhou.

t: 在Castro nostro Vizoka vocum 从老城镇维索基.
te: King Tvrtko I of Bosnia writes In castro nostro Vizoka vocatum from the Old town of Visoki.
dz: 波斯尼亚国王特夫特克一世写道: 在Castro nostro Vizoka vocum 从老城镇维索基.
